sentiment.summary: Only one of three retrieved items is about Solana: CoinDesk reported that a routing glitch at a major data center provider knocked nearly 29% of staked tokens offline and Marinade Finance said the network neared a freeze threshold, while Foundation executives said blocks and transactions never stopped. The other items cover Metaplanet Bitcoin transfers and Zerohash’s U.S. trust-bank pitch, not Solana. Reddit authentication failed, and grounding and YouTube returned no results, so there are not three relevant records from two independent ok sources.
sentiment.coverage_note: Cointelegraph and CoinDesk RSS were ok and returned three items in the 30-day window; Ethereum Foundation RSS was ok but contributed no items. Grounding and YouTube had no results; Reddit auth-failed. Only one item is Solana-relevant, from a single named source.
